scope: Human review of four PE-I2I rewrites; no downstream diffusion generation or Adapter training

tiktok_03.target_photo: Markedly backward head tilt; chin upward
tiktok_03.normal_visualization: Upward head orientation is visually present
tiktok_03.legs: Body25 knees and ankles are invalid; DWPose includes out-of-frame knee coordinates and low-confidence ankle/foot estimates, yet leg segments remain in the rendered skeleton

tiktok_05.target_photo: Both fists reach forward toward the camera
tiktok_05.normal_visualization: Hands appear loose/open rather than the target fists; condition already differs from the target photograph
tiktok_05.legs: Body25 knees and ankles are invalid; DWPose knee coordinates are outside the frame and ankle/foot estimates have low confidence, yet leg segments remain in the rendered skeleton

cases.head: Rewritten as frontal head and upright neck; does not match reviewed target head tilt
cases.arms: Coarse lowering of arms; finer details are not established as accurate
cases.interpretation: 2D face keypoints alone did not resolve head pitch in this case

cases.head: Rewritten as chin lifted and face toward ceiling; high-level head direction matches the target
cases.legs: Specifies standing with feet apart, without reliable foot evidence
cases.interpretation: Adding normal and depth jointly improved one head description; contribution of each modality is not isolated

cases.hands: Open spread hands at hip height; does not recover forward fists
cases.legs: Specifies straight legs and feet apart, without reliable foot evidence
cases.interpretation: Do not attribute solely to PE: skeleton hand estimates and perspective cues are imperfect

cases.hands: Hands move in front of torso between waist and chest, but fingers remain relaxed/open rather than forward fists
cases.legs: Specifies separated legs and bent knees; exact pose is not supported by reliable knee/foot keypoints
cases.interpretation: Input normal already depicts loose hands; text-versus-geometry conflict must be audited upstream

conclusions: Geometry-conditioned PE rewriting is feasible as a candidate generator
Valid JSON does not establish semantic correctness
Filter unreliable visualization segments and extract confidence-aware facts before rewriting
Compile image-role references for the actual downstream protocol; current full Adapter RGB input is A only
Keep geometry camera and native pixel-canvas contract independent of PE ratio suggestions
limitations: Two selected cases, one PE sampling seed, four rewrites; not a statistical accuracy benchmark
Normal and depth were added together; no independent modality attribution
Some geometry estimates differ from the actual target photograph
Probe requested posture/head editing, not expression transfer; preserving source expression here is not an expression-transfer test
No evidence yet that these rewrites improve downstream generated images
Validator/compiler and follow-up image ablation are proposed, not implemented
recommendation: Task attribute contract + audited actual geometry + reliable facts + PE candidate + semantic checks + downstream-role compilation; compare against manually verified prompts with model and Adapter frozen
